original.prompt: Consider the following statements about the India–South Korea Foreign Policy and Security Dialogue (FPSD):
items: The 6th round of the dialogue was held in Seoul in February 2026.
The 2014 round of the dialogue focused on defence.
The 2023 round of the dialogue focused on economic security.
original.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: The 2023 round focused on post-COVID resilience. Economic security became the focus in the 2026 round. That round, held in Seoul, gave most weight to shipbuilding, critical minerals and AI.
original.source: In 2014, it was about defence; by 2023, it was post-COVID resilience.
